available_candidate_slices.why: Unknown turns are currently safest as clarification. Splitting unknowns requires evidence that a subtype has a safer deterministic route.

available_candidate_slices.why: Any classifier expansion must prove it does not swallow support, do-not-call, payment, healthcare, coverage, voicemail, human-request, or email-only boundaries.
